title: Model-category localization detects weak equivalences
statement: Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category in the sense of [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction], with weak equivalences $W$, and let $\gamma:\mathcal M\to\mathcal H$ be an ordinary localization at $W$ (initial among functors sending $W$ to isomorphisms). Work in universes in which this localization exists. For every morphism $u:X\to Y$ of $\mathcal M$, $u\in W$ if and only if $\gamma(u)$ is an isomorphism in $\mathcal H$. Neither $X$ nor $Y$ is assumed cofibrant or fibrant.

source.place: Additional model-category foundation for the finite mapping-complex comparison: detecting weak equivalences after evaluation on cofibrant dg diagram values. This is not an assertion of a Stacks tag.
